user_intent_summary: Design a compact desktop lifting box that uses a hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform by 80-100 mm, supporting 1 kg, with the mechanism enclosed and the product safe, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture.
product_intent: A compact desktop lifting device that enables manual vertical movement of an internal platform through external rotation, with specified lift range and payload capacity, while maintaining mechanical integrity and usability requirements.

clauses.text: Design a compact desktop lifting box
The user should rotate an external hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform
The platform should lift approximately 80-100 mm
and support a payload of approximately 1 kg
The mechanism should be enclosed inside the housing
The product should be safe to use, mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture
Avoid obvious jamming or unstable operation
Continuous or intermittent lifting is acceptable
Multiple shafts, bearings, guides, and supports are allowed

requirements.statement: The product must enable a user to rotate an external hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform

verification.observable: platform movement in response to crank rotation

requirements.statement: The internal platform must lift approximately 80-100 mm
The internal platform must support a payload of approximately 1 kg
The product must enclose the mechanism inside the housing
The product must be safe to use
The product must be mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture
The product must avoid obvious jamming or unstable operation

verification.observable: smooth operation without jamming or instability

requirements.statement: The product must operate manually only

verification.observable: absence of power source or automated systems

freedoms.subject: lifting operation continuity
freedoms.statement: Continuous or intermittent lifting is acceptable

freedoms.subject: mechanism components
freedoms.statement: Multiple shafts, bearings, guides, and supports are allowed

relations.rationale: Platform lifting must be accomplished through crank rotation
Platform must support payload during operation
Easy assembly and manufacturability may conflict with avoiding jamming or instability

operating_scenarios.name: Normal Operation
operating_scenarios.description: User rotates hand crank to raise or lower platform within specified range while supporting payload

operating_scenarios.description: Product operates without jamming or unstable operation under normal user handling and payload conditions

operating_scenarios.name: Assembly and Manufacturing
operating_scenarios.description: Product is designed for easy assembly and practical manufacturing while maintaining mechanical integrity
